change.summary: Load each aligned group of four contiguous FP32 probabilities once, multiply by the unchanged inverse denominator lane-wise, and store one float4 into the shared V128 PV stage.
change.scope: Select the vector transport only for dense-initial gfx1151 exact long-global decode with a four-float-aligned score stride; retain scalar V128 for other strides and V80 after explicit eviction or on peer backends.
change.unchanged: Tokenloop4 GQA6 score ownership, exact max/exp/sum order, FP32 probability values, chronological prefetch16 probability/V FMA order, D32 output ownership, softplus gate, BF16 rounding, allocations, and the complete KVLiveSpans ABI.
